summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that it has postponed its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders from November 13, 2026 to December 21, 2026. The filing is signed by Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary Jim Plohg and contains no deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural terms. This is a routine scheduling notice, not a special situation; the only item to watch is any proxy contest or activist-driven solicitation that may motivate the delay.
